text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sudden high request spike to /v1/embeddings since 4181999800. 3k rps sustained, error rate creeping to ~5% (502/429). Pattern: many distinct API keys, similar UA 'curl/7.68.0 (bot)'. Possible credential-probe + scraper fanout. Auto-detectors flagged abnormal prefix cache churn.

carol_oncall: I'm on it — taking lead. Paging infra/security. First triage: reduce fanout surface and apply short-lived slices.

frank_infra: Rolling a global ingress slice (factor 0.35) to slow non-auth traffic and reduce burst. Running: `POST https://admin.internal/quota/slice 
{ 
  "scope": "global", 
  "factor": 0.35, 
  "duration_seconds": 1800 
}` — doing now.

bob_security: Deploying WAF rule to block UA regex and known bot ASNs. Rule id 8421: `ua =~ /curl\\/7\\.68\\.0/ OR ip_asn in (12345,67890)` -> challenge or block. Also toggled captcha-challenge for suspect IP ranges.

carol_oncall: Throttled per-api-key to 10 r/s (soft) and hardened quota enforcement for anonymous keys. Disabled embeddings bulk endpoint to prevent fanout: `/v1/embeddings/bulk` -> disabled.

frank_infra: Command run: `rbctl route update --service embeddings --disable bulk` -> success. Rolling restream config to reduce concurrency per-worker.

dave_product: Any confirmed customer impact? Which customers seeing errors/timeouts? Need list for comms.

eve_support: Seeing 4 active support tickets from SMB customers reporting timeouts on embed calls. Logging a shared ticket and triage note. Preparing draft notice.

gina_cx: Hold on customer notice until we verify stability. Draft should say: short degraded embed availability, mitigations in progress, ETA updates.

hannah_research: Traffic payloads skew tiny (prompt len < 40) which aligns with scraping fingerprints. KV cache hit rates dropped 60% locally. Looks like probes trying many keys + small payloads to maximize fanout.

carol_oncall: Added geo-slice for APAC (heavier throttle) and put stricter caps on new API keys. Keeping rule 8421 live. Monitoring dashboards and traces. If false positive, rollback path is `rbctl route update --service embeddings --enable bulk` + remove WAF rule 8421.

alice_sre: Backup oncall here, watching. After slices: CPU on embeddings backends down ~18%, queue length down 55%. :thumbsup:

frank_infra: Also limited async batch workers to 50% to avoid downstream overload. Engine team suggested temp-disable prefetch triggered by small input size.

bob_security: Flagging this as P2 for now. If traffic persists past 45m or we see credential stuffing patterns tied to high-value accounts, escalate to P1 and open full incident channel.

dave_product: Thinking about automatic fallback: route paying customers to a low-latency cached embedding model variant if we see fanout high — can we enable a policy?

frank_infra: We have a policy toggle. Can enable `fallback:premium->model:embed-lite` for customers with tag `paying:true`. Will prepare a canary rule.

carol_oncall: Decision: keep current mitigations for 30 more minutes, maintain WAF rule, per-key throttles, bulk endpoint disabled. Prepare customer comms if errors persist. Re-evaluate at 4182000365.

eve_support: Draft notice staged at https://internal/docs/incidents/4182000000-notice — will send after stability window or earlier if asked.

incident-bot: Update: 10m after mitigations traffic down ~70%, error rate normalized to baseline. Continuing to monitor for recurrence.

carol_oncall: Great. Leave slices in place for full 30m window. If we see re-escalation, we'll open P1 and loop in exec. Thanks all for rapid response. :white_check_mark:
